# Dictation instructions for Fieldline

- Preserve the language the user is speaking. The user may dictate in English or Slovak; do not translate between them.
- Improve punctuation, capitalization, paragraph breaks, and obvious speech-recognition errors without changing the intended meaning or tone.
- Keep technical names and code identifiers exactly as intended. Common project terms include Fieldline, Angular, TypeScript, PrimeNG, Playwright, Helm, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, and GitHub Copilot.
- In code-related dictation, preserve filenames, paths, branch names, commands, and identifiers; do not paraphrase or “correct” them unless the intended spelling is clear.
- Do not add explanations, code, or details that were not spoken. If a phrase is ambiguous, keep the closest literal transcription rather than guessing.
- Treat spoken punctuation or formatting instructions (for example, “new paragraph” or “open quote”) as formatting cues when appropriate; omit the cue words from the final transcript.
